item.description:
Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 211)

  • GitHub pull requests now have a native glass panel with GitHub status colors, review details, checks, discussion and branch update controls.
  • The GitHub toolbar status appears when a matching PR is found, with a short entrance animation that respects Reduce Motion. Required reviews are shown as red merge blockers.
  • Keep the PR panel open for action confirmations; GitHub permissions and the current PR head are checked again before guarded actions.
  • Improve browser translation controls, remember the last translation language, and show the Devkitty cat on new tabs.
  • Carry forward workspace recovery, browser lifecycle, terminal link and widget fixes from recent previews.
  • Add configurable PostHog diagnostics and feature flags. Session Replay stays off.

The legacy dashboard and experimental iTerm2/cmux importer are hidden while their replacements are refined. An intermittent split-terminal Cmd-W exit remains unreproduced and is not claimed fixed.
